mapper.insert: insert into fitian.Channel (boxCode, channelId, channelName, type, createdBy, createdAt) values (#{boxCode}, #{channelId}, #{channelName}, #{type}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: select channelId, channelName, type from fitian.Channel where boxCode = #{boxCode}
select channelId, channelName, type from fitian.Channel where boxCode = #{boxCode} and type = #{type}
